full_name: Kristala Jones Prather | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Engineering & Computer Science Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Kristala Jones Prather is the Theodore T. Miller Associate Professor of Chemical Engineering at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and an investigator in the Synthetic Biology Engineering Research Center, funded by the National Science Foundation.
